description: This Java class 'AddressTemplate' extends 'LayoutTemplate' and implements 'Serializable'. It provides address layout configuration support, defining tokens and support instances for address layouts within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: AddressTemplate
classes.description: Represents an address layout template within the OpenMRS system, providing methods to retrieve tokens and support instances for address layouts.

methods.name: AddressTemplate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AddressTemplate with a string parameter, passing it to the superclass constructor.

methods.name: getLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the token string representing address layout elements.

methods.name: getNonLayoutToken
methods.description: Returns the token string that indicates non-address layout elements.

methods.name: getLayoutSupportInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of AddressSupport, which manages address layout support.

methods.name: getCodeName
methods.description: Returns the code name for the template, defaulting to 'default' if none is set.
